content: Common onboarding pitfall: exposing full hobbyist taxonomy (mechanic names like 'card drafting', 'worker placement', numeric weight) to new players creates jargon overload. Best practice is progressive disclosure -- reveal core mechanic first, secondary/meta mechanics later (seen in Zombie Kidz Evolution's sealed-envelope unlocks, mobile game onboarding layering). Terms are learned naturally through repeated exposure, not by front-loading a glossary.
